purpose: Windows utility functions: UTF-8/wide string conversion, module directory resolution, file I/O, path combination, and file:// URI construction.
calls_out_to: MultiByteToWideChar / WideCharToMultiByte — UTF-8 ↔ wide char conversion
UrlCreateFromPathW — converts Windows path to file:// URI
invariants: Utf8ToWide falls back to CP_ACP if the input fails strict UTF-8 validation
GetModuleDirectory retries with doubling buffer until path fits
CombinePath uses PathAppendW which handles trailing backslashes correctly
gotchas: CombinePath uses a fixed MAX_PATH buffer — paths longer than MAX_PATH will be silently truncated
PathToFileUri requires a probe call (urlLength=0, returns E_POINTER) to determine the output buffer size before the actual call
